name: Mind Grind
oracle_text: Each opponent reveals cards from the top of their library until they reveal X land cards, then puts all cards revealed this way into their graveyard. X can't be 0.
blocked_sentences: Each opponent reveals cards from the top of their library until they reveal X land cards, then puts all cards revealed this way into their graveyard.

needs.what: a remainder destination on `reveal_until` (e.g. `rest_to: "graveyard"`) so the non-land cards revealed before the X-th land go to their owner's graveyard together with the matched lands (`destination: "graveyard"`, `amount: {"x": true}`, `player: "each_opponent"`), as one move -- "reveals cards from the top of their library until they reveal X land cards, then puts all cards revealed this way into their graveyard" (Mind Grind, Mind Funeral)
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `op_reveal_until` (ops_cards.py) already counts `amount` matches and walks each opponent's library, but moves only the hits to `destination`; the other revealed cards go to the bottom in a random order (`rest_to_bottom`, defaulted on) or are shuffled back (`shuffle_rest`), and switching both off leaves them on top -- no key sends them to the graveyard. `look_at_top` has `rest_to` but a fixed window, not an unbounded 'until'. `repeat_while` around `mill` 1 is an approximation: it is a mill (701.13), firing mill triggers and `replace_mill` the printed reveal never does, moving cards one at a time, and capped by the iteration guard. "X can't be 0" is expressible as card-level `x_minimum: 1`; only the reveal-and-bin is blocked.
